comment: Registry subtrees required for 3ds Max 2025 on a fresh Windows Server 2022 SMF worker. Discovered empirically via before/after reg.exe export diff around a real Setup.exe -q install (29,543 added keys total; see REGISTRY-KEYS.md). Values are NOT stored here: the cold path captures them with 'reg.exe export' into .reg files on the persistent volume, the warm path replays them with 'reg.exe import'. Services are re-registered from the JSON captures via 'sc.exe create' (a registry import alone is not visible to SCM until reboot).

production.comment: What host-config/3dsmax-2025-pv-cached.ps1 Export-InstallerState captures. Minimal set, validated by 3dsmaxbatch -help + AdskLicensingInstHelper on a true warm boot. See openQuestion12 for the COM gap.

iteration.comment: What iteration/09-build-graft.ps1 captured (az3 volume, autodesk-graft.reg, 4,125 keys / 1.3 MB): the production subtrees PLUS every installer-added key outside HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft. Superset; use this approach if real renders fail on missing COM registrations.

subtrees.HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows (Inst: render path does not need it; importing invites servicing operations

autodeskSubtreeContents.comment: Observed children of HKLM\SOFTWARE\Autodesk created by the 2025 installer (key counts from the diff).

services.comment: Captured as JSON (not .reg) because warm boot re-registers via sc.exe create for immediate SCM visibility. Fields captured: Name, DisplayName, PathName, StartMode, StartName, Description.

list.name: FlexNet Licensing Service 64
list.payloadCapture: robocopy 'C:\Program Files\Common Files\Macrovision Shared' -> D:\Software\MacrovisionShared and C:\ProgramData\FLEXnet -> D:\SoftwareData\FLEXnet
list.warmBootPolicy: restore files by robocopy, then create + start

list.name: Autodesk Access Service Host
list.warmBootPolicy: create then DISABLE (render workers do not need Autodesk Access)

openQuestion12: Production graft omits the ~3,100 COM keys (CLSID/Interface/TypeLib/Record). 3dsmaxbatch -help and licensing validate without them; a full scene render may not. If renders fail with COM/class-not-registered errors, adopt the iteration capture (before/after export diff) on the cold path.

capturedArtifactLocations.az3 volume-5bef90e3d0ad4ecdb45a868794e49: D:\SoftwareRegistry\graft\autodesk-graft.reg + services\* (iteration layout) and D:\SoftwareRegistry\snapshots\{before,after}-*.reg full-hive exports + added-software-keys.txt (complete 29,543-key list)
